name: fibroblast growth factor 23

function.text: FGF23 encodes fibroblast growth factor 23 [Cleaved into: Fibroblast growth factor 23 N-terminal peptide; Fibroblast growth factor 23 C-terminal peptide]. Annotated molecular activities include growth factor activity and type 1 fibroblast growth factor receptor binding. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and neurogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal dominant hypophosphatemic rickets (autosomal dominant); tumoral calcinosis, hyperphosphatemic, familial, 2 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Genomics England PanelApp. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
